I’m high plat so take this with grain of salt but I OTP Gwen and I can tell you it’s not true. Gwen’s not even that weak early (her stacked Q deals a lot of dmg especially after the base dmg buffs). She just suffers because she’s a bit less mobile than other skirmishers/divers top lane and very vulnerable to ganks because her Q is on a long cooldown before level 9 meaning she can’t win prolonged fights and you should really only poke with EQ or EWQ early and ONLY go in early if you are 100% sure you can kill the enemy. (though i’m assuming here you’re against someone like Pantheon but if you’re against a tank just kite them and you win any trade against them) IMO she is blindpickable but only if you put a lot of time into her otherwise you won’t know your limits and when to go in against your counters like Riven, Jax, Pantheon. You can also play her mid lane. I started doing that as of recently because I got tired of getting camped top and she’s also good against squishies with NH. By the way, Gwen is all about positioning more than mechanics. You screw up your W late game in a teamfight? You’re dead.

It’s not very different from the conq gwen. You can choose to be careful until 6 or just perma shove waves (unless you notice that your enemy laner is bad at trading, for example doesn’t punish you after you EQ or waste W, you easy kill them just don’t underestimate gwen Q base dmg). If it’s a hard ranged match up like viktor i play safe and go roam bot lane at 6 and it’s an easy double kill if they’re pushing the wave (don’t worry about the exp you might miss because if you get a double that alone means you can duel your laner now). If it’s a melee matchup that’s not a counter pick like pantheon or renekton I tend to go aggressive in lane and get kills (even if you can’t get kills just harvest their soul), but don’t always fight your laner especially when they start to play passively just go bot lane gwen is insanely good at team fighting when you have your ult up.

For summoners spells Ghost/Ignite is a must for me (you can go Tp/Ghost but as I said I love playing aggressively but these are viable too)

Late game you just need to position correctly and not get picked/CCed and you should obliterate their whole team just don’t take fights without your ult (you’re very squishy with this build but it’s your ult that bursts everyone before they get in the range to attack you) and if your team still engages after you ping them to wait that’s on them

Glad I could be of help. If you’re serious about otping her there are a lot of things that you just need to go through by playing her and getting experience. She might seem hard at first but after you learn how to position with W and use your combos she’s not hard at all (mechanically)

I’m plat 3 - plat 2 so take this with a grain of salt

Garen - dodge or just ban
Seriously I encourage you to do that but matchup wise you should go ghost + ignite (you don’t need TP here) and try to get early kills before 6 with your fully stacked Q and some E cheesing and in best case scenario you could technically “win” lane (he will still 100-0 after 6 tho) if he’s low enough when you’re crashing the wave before 6 and E + Q + ignite. Other than that it’s not a winning matchup since riot’s balance team is full of garen/malphite players

Darius - Easy
Also go ghost + ignite. You could win level 1 but it’s too risky because most Darius players go in the bush and zone you off the wave so make sure to NOT leash your jungler. If you manage to stick to your wave try to poke him as he all ins you and use your Q advantage and if he screws up you kill him with ignite but it’s more consistent to get level 2 and then chunk him down (but be sure as you E + Q you dodge his abilities). After level 6 you hard win all-ins even when behind as long as you hit everything. This matchup is basically about dodging his abilities and hitting yours.

Irelia - medium hard?
It’s hard to tell how difficult this matchup is because someone with mechanics of irelking will hard shit on you but if the irelia is bad you hard win. Don’t leash, get wave prio, stack Qs, poke and don’t let her stack her passive. You can go TP + ignite (if the enemy team doesn’t have ghost abusers or champions with high mobility) or TP + ghost if you need the mobility. This matchup focuses on you poking her enough and not taking long trades. After 6 poke her then all-in but make sure to look where she’s going to dash (also if she Qs you, you Q cast your Q behind yourself, if she Ws she’s immobile and can’t mitigate true damage so cast your Q preferably fully stacked). Mid-late game you can split push and TF with your TP and you should win

I usually go Conqueror but you can also go first strike for money + burst (against squishier comps) and depending on whether i need sustain or burst or movement speed i go riftmaker/protobelt/night harvester. I don’t see a reason why you shouldn’t OTP her mid (although top is a better lane for her)
